messages:
alex: quick incident summary: another OOM during peak writes. Symptoms: steady kv.residency increase on a subset of shards, high slab fragmentation, occasional large pinned objects from batch-merge.
rachel: saw the alert, grabbed the heap snapshot from node-11 before it restarted. Uploading to profiles: s3://redwood-profiles/3512401234/node-11-heap.pb
dan: initial triage: two concurrent issues: 1) session-indexing fast-path skips lru-touch (logical leak) 2) allocator bucket for 48-80B not using small-object pooling, leads to fragmentation.
megan: thanks. proposing a two-track remediation: immediate mitigation (soft cap + eviction hysteresis) and medium-term fix (consolidate LRU + pooled allocator + eviction watermarking).
joel: immediate plan: flip `oomguard.soft_cap=true` for canary shards 10 & 11, add `kv.eviction.hysteresis=5%` to avoid thrash. Canary run for 4h.
priya: assign owners now: alex -> end-to-end repro + heap diffs; dan -> code audit for LRU touches; megan -> GC + allocator tuning PR; rachel -> canary orchestration and dashboards; joel -> runbook and rollback playbook.
alex: repro script created and uploaded to infra: gitlab.com/redwood/infra/kv-repro/-/blob/main/repro_small_allocs.py. It simulates 3k req/s with random small writes and intermittent large batches.
rachel: canary started at 3512403000 on nodes node-10,node-11. Baseline snapshots taken. sre-bot: Canary deployment triggered by joel. Alerts set: residency>72% (warn), residency>85% (pager).
megan: GC/allocator quick changes I've opened as PR #5212: - enable pooled slabs for 48-80B - add a compaction pass triggered when shard residency delta > 8% in 10m - emit metrics: allocator.pools.hits, allocator.pools.misses.
dan: code review note: session-indexing encoder had two codepaths; the fast-path's Put() didn't call touchLRU(). Patch in my branch (MR !667) calls touchLRU() and adds a unit test.
alex: heap diff shows ~2.6MB of persistent 64B blobs per shard retained with zero LRU refs. That matches the logical leak finding.
joel: runbook checklist: 1) enable soft_cap 2) enable compaction pass 3) monitor p95/p99 latency and eviction.reclaimed_bytes 4) if p95 > 30% rollback 5) escalate to postmortem if >1 OOM in 12h. I've added steps and commands. snippet: ```bash
# enable soft cap on canary
curl -X POST $CONTROL_PLANE/api/v1/config -d '{"oomguard.soft_cap":true}'
```
priya: timeline: - canary live now - alex: heap repro + write reproducible steps (due in 4h) - dan: merge LRU-touch patch to canary (due in 2h) - megan: land allocator PR to feature branch and smoke test (due EOD) - rachel: dashboard panels + alert tweaks (done in 1h) - joel: publish runbook + rollout schedule (2h)
megan: note on metrics to add: `kv.allocator.unusable_bytes`, `kv.eviction.rate_per_minute`, `kv.compactor.run_count`. Will add to per-shard dashboard.
alex: small follow-up: we should also add a perf/unit test that stresses slab fragmentation, something like `AllocatorTest.SmallObjectBurst` to catch regressions. I'll draft it.
dan: merged LRU-touch to canary branch at 3512408000. Monitoring for changes.
rachel: early canary telemetry: residency growth stopped on node-10 but node-11 still creeping up slightly. eviction.reclaimed_bytes increased, allocator.pools.hits up 12%. p95 latency unchanged.
sre-bot: Alert: node-11 residency crossed 74% at 3512409120 (warn).
joel: action: pause background batch jobs on node-11 and restart compactor. Doing now.
priya: longer-term architectural items for postmortem: - global LRU vs per-shard LRU tradeoffs - shard-level compaction scheduler (staggered windows) - bounded background job concurrency to avoid simultaneous compaction pressure - add regression tests for small-object pooling
megan: scheduling idea: compaction windows = shard_id % 6 * 10m, cap compaction CPU at 15% per node. Will prototype.
alex: added INF-9901 to track postmortem actions and link to MR/PRs. Please add your PR links there.
rachel: canary stabilized after background pause; node-11 residency plateaued and started decreasing after compactor restart. No OOMs in 5h.
joel: staged rollout plan: 10% of shards next 3h -> 30% next 6h -> full if stable. Rollback: revert oomguard.soft_cap and disable compaction pass.
sre-bot: Update: Canary passed 6h threshold. Scheduling staged rollout at 3512410800.
priya: meeting: postmortem follow-up scheduled tomorrow 10:30. Please bring: heap diffs, allocator metrics, runbook draft, engineering plan (owner & ETA).
megan: follow-ups assigned: - implement compaction scheduler prototype (megan) - add allocation unit tests (alex) - finalize runbook + rollback (joel) - complete LRU consolidation design doc (dan).
alex: closing note: thanks for quick ops and clear owners. Let's make sure these fixes have unit/regression tests before prod-wide rollouts.
